'''H33 Division''' was the designation of a [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], from the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].
